title: Two populations share one fleet
caption: Kalos language-model cluster trace, 19,907 jobs: single-GPU jobs are 86% of submissions but about 0.1% of GPU-time, while 256+-GPU jobs are ~4% of submissions and ~96% of GPU-time. The scheduler's fairness problem is that the two bars describe the same fleet.

title: The interruption tax on spot savings
caption: Illustrative billed-hour split per retained training hour, middle bar anchored to the chapter scenario: \$344,064 on-demand vs \$161,567 spot for the same run — a nominal 65% discount settling to ~52%, an overhead ratio near 0.37. Rare interruptions keep the discount nearly whole; frequent ones can erase it.
